study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Hua et al., Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging, 2025
study_identification_part.si4_title: Adjustment of Regional Cortical Thickness Measures for Global Cortical Thickness Obscures Deficits Across the Schizophrenia Spectrum: A Cautionary Note About Normative Modeling of Brain Imaging Data

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: To demonstrate that adjusting regional cortical thickness for global cortical thickness attenuates or eliminates true disease-related effects in schizophrenia-spectrum cohorts, and to caution against incorporating global thickness as a mandatory covariate in normative modeling tools.

rci1_dataset_name.reason: Study 1 recruited from UCSF early psychosis research clinic; Study 2 from the Human Connectome Project–Early Psychosis (HCPEP).

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Group profile analyses via repeated-measures MANOVA (nonparallelism and level differences), ANCOVA for global thickness differences, ROI-wise regressions testing Group×Global interactions, and permutation analysis (scrambling global thickness) with Bonferroni corrections.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Adjusting regional cortical thickness for global thickness obscures or eliminates disease-related regional deficits, whereas ICV adjustment preserves expected deficit patterns.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: Abstract and results show strong global–regional correlations; schizophrenia-spectrum groups have lower global thickness. Regional deficits in ESZ and NAff-P are robust without global adjustment but are attenuated/eliminated when global thickness is covaried. Sensitivity analyses indicate ICV adjustment yields profiles closely resembling non-ICV-adjusted results with significant nonparallelism and level differences among groups (e.g., Study 1 ICV-adjusted nonparallelism F[66,368]=1.80, p<.001; level differences F[2,216]=17.44, p<.001; Study 2 ICV-adjusted nonparallelism F[66,268]=1.65, p=.003; level differences F[2,166]=17.35, p<.001).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Prospective scanner harmonization across HCP-EP sites (identical hardware/sequences; traveling phantoms); site included as covariate. Permutation analysis (scrambled global thickness) illustrates how global adjustment removes true effects; ICV provides a more appropriate global covariate.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: Not explicitly detailed in provided text; discussion focuses on methodological caution rather than exhaustive limitations.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Journal indicated by cover as Biological Psychiatry: Cognitive Neuroscience and Neuroimaging; DOI suggests 2024 acceptance, but file naming indicates 2025 publication. This is a methodological caution paper using within-study normative z-scores rather than pre-trained reference models.
